title: The Importance of Moral Motivation in the Tarbiyah of the Child

text_simplified: A child needs continuous motivation and encouragement to learn positive behaviors. The reward should be moral before it is material, such as praise and hugs. It is important that encouragement does not become a condition for performing duties, but rather is unexpected to reinforce new behavior.
